name: pueue
title: Pueue
description: Manage the Pueue task queue daemon from Raycast: browse and act on tasks, follow live output, control groups and parallelism, and watch the queue from the menu bar.
author: da-wei_lee

commands.name: tasks
commands.title: Tasks
commands.description: Browse, filter, and act on Pueue tasks; view or follow their output.

preferences.name: showDetail
preferences.title: Detail Pane
preferences.label: Show the detail pane by default
preferences.description: Show task metadata and a log preview beside the list. Toggle at any time with ⌘⇧D.

preferences.name: detailLogLines
preferences.title: Log Preview Lines
preferences.description: How many trailing log lines to show in the detail pane for the selected task. Higher values cost one extra `pueue log` call per selection change.

commands.name: add-task
commands.title: Add Task
commands.description: Queue a shell command with a working directory, group, label, priority, dependencies, and delay.

commands.name: quick-add
commands.title: Quick Add Task
commands.description: Queue a command straight from root search, using your last-used group and working directory.

commands.name: groups
commands.title: Groups
commands.description: List Pueue groups, pause or resume them, change parallelism, and add or remove groups.

commands.name: queue-menu
commands.title: Queue Menu Bar
commands.description: Show running, queued, and failed task counts in the menu bar with one-click actions.

preferences.name: titleCounts
preferences.title: Menu Bar Title
preferences.description: What number to show next to the icon. The title is hidden entirely when the chosen counts are all zero.

preferences.name: maxItemsPerSection
preferences.title: Items per Section
preferences.description: How many tasks to list under Running / Queued / Failed before collapsing into an "…and N more" item. Keeps a large queue from rendering hundreds of menu items every minute.

preferences.name: showGroups
preferences.title: Groups Section
preferences.label: Show a Groups section
preferences.description: Adds one submenu per group with pause / resume and a parallelism picker.

preferences.name: menuQuery
preferences.title: Menu Bar Query
preferences.description: Optional Pueue query applied to the menu bar's status read, e.g. "last 100". Useful when you keep thousands of finished tasks around. Leave empty for all tasks.

preferences.name: pueuePath
preferences.title: Pueue Binary Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the `pueue` client. Empty = auto-probe /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, ~/.cargo/bin, ~/.local/bin. `pueued` is looked for beside it. Raycast runs under launchd with no shell rc, so a bare `pueue` is never on PATH.

preferences.name: configPath
preferences.title: Pueue Config Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to pueue.yml. Empty = let pueue use its default (~/Library/Application Support/pueue/pueue.yml on macOS). Also used to locate the task_logs directory.

preferences.name: connections
preferences.title: Remote Connections
preferences.description: One per line. Simplest form is just an SSH host you can already reach — everything runs over ssh, nothing to set up: "local_ubuntu". Or "name | ssh-host" to label it. Advanced: "name | ~/pueue/client.yml | ssh-host" reads through a forwarded socket and submits over ssh.

preferences.name: confirmDestructive
preferences.title: Confirmations
preferences.label: Confirm kill, remove, clean, and reset
preferences.description: Ask before destructive actions in the view commands. Menu bar destructive actions are always behind ⌥ regardless of this setting.
